settings.title: Our story
settings.description: Beautifully crafted, built to last, and rooted in purpose.

settings.heading: We're Anita & Ashok.
settings.description:
Fig & Mouse was created with a simple belief: the things we buy for our dogs should be just as thoughtfully designed as the things we buy for ourselves; beautifully crafted, built to last, and rooted in purpose.

Our story began long before the brand did. We met while working together in the fashion industry, where we discovered a shared appreciation for thoughtful design and quality craftsmanship. Somewhere along the way, we also fell in love with one another and built a life together, surrounded by the love of our animals.

settings.heading: From Lucy to Fig.
settings.description:
In addition to our beloved senior pug, Lucy, we welcomed Mouse into our family after adopting her through Pug Nation LA. When Lucy passed away after a long, happy, and deeply loved life, we never imagined another dog would find us quite so soon.

Then, just five months later, Fig showed up in our front yard while we were out of state, as if she had fallen from the sky. No one came forward to claim her, and we knew within moments of meeting her that she was meant to be part of our family. It felt fortuitous, as though Lucy had sent us a special friend.

settings.heading: The Impact
settings.description:
Our lives are richer because of our dogs. We wanted to create something that celebrated them while bringing together our passion for classic design, premium quality, and purpose. Every Fig & Mouse collection is inspired by the joy, personality, and unconditional love our dogs bring into our lives. Designed with comfort, durability, and understated style in mind, our products are made to be just as functional as they are beautiful.

But Fig & Mouse is about more than thoughtfully designed pet essentials. Rescue dogs changed our lives, and giving back is woven into everything we do. That's why we proudly donate 5% of every sale to Pug Nation LA, helping more dogs find the loving homes they deserve.

Thank you for supporting a small business built by dog lovers, for dog lovers. By choosing our brand, you're not only investing in beautifully made essentials, you're helping rescue dogs along the way.

Welcome to Fig & Mouse. We are thrilled you have chosen to Walk with Purpose.

settings.question: How do I find the right size?
settings.answer: Check our size guide on each product page. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up for comfort.

settings.question: What does the 5% actually support?
settings.answer: 5% of every purchase goes directly to rescue organizations and shelters helping dogs find their forever homes.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping is available for 1-2 day delivery.

settings.question: Do the collections coordinate?
settings.answer: Yes! Each collection is designed to mix and match. Check out our styling guide for inspiration.
